process.title: One partner for the whole processing line
process.subtitle: A fully automatic line covering all nine stages, with machines designed to work together.

steps.title: Raw nut grading
steps.description: Sort raw nuts by size so each group steams and splits evenly.

steps.title: Steaming
steps.description: Make shells brittle in a static or rotary steamer.

steps.title: Shelling
steps.description: Split each nut and release the kernel with minimal breakage.

steps.title: Drying
steps.description: Lower kernel moisture so the testa loosens.

steps.title: Humidifying
steps.description: Condition kernels so they stay whole during peeling.

steps.title: Peeling
steps.description: Remove the testa skin gently and evenly.

steps.title: Air compression
steps.description: Supply high-pressure dry air for pneumatic peeling.

steps.title: Kernel grading
steps.description: Sort kernels by size into export grades.

steps.title: Packing
steps.description: Vacuum pack kernels for long shelf life.

markets.title: Helping cashew-growing countries process at home
markets.subtitle: Instead of exporting raw nuts, growing countries can process them locally and keep the value, jobs, and skills at home. Our plants make that shift possible.
